'''''Resistance Reborn''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Rebecca Roanhorse]]. It is part of the [[Journey to Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'']] publishing program, and it was first published on [[November 5]], [[2019]] by [[Del Rey]], with an [[Resistance Reborn (audiobook)|audiobook]] version releasing on the same day. ''Resistance Reborn'' is set immediately after the events of the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], and it serves as a prequel to [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], illustrating the beginning of the [[Resistance]]'s way to regain military power by assembling allies, new leaders, pilots, and ships after the defeat at the [[Battle of Crait]].

{{Quote|So, what do we do now? We scatter to every corner of the galaxy, taking our message with us. We help those already fighting the First Order, we make allies, we sow the spark of Resistance. And when the time comes, we will be ready. We will rise up, and we will fight. And all of us, together, will burn the First Order to the ground.|[[Poe Dameron]]‘s first speech, outlining the future of the Resistance|<ref name="Resistance Reborn">''[[Resistance Reborn]]''</ref>}}
